承接 `v0.0.10`（首个 Release）。本版是**文档与面板**的一次整理，外加两个真 bug 修复 ——
**没有新增工具、没有改任何工具的调用方式**（四条 AI 调用不变量全部保持）。

<h3 id="cn-v0.0.11">新增功能</h3>

- **面板：版本行 + Host 自陈旧警告**。面板以前**不显示版本**；而 Host 半边是**启动时的快照** —— 源码 22:41 改到 0.0.9、Host 是 22:18 启动的仍报 0.0.5，定位花掉 5 个调用。现在面板顶部常显 `Host vX · 启动 HH:MM · 源码 vY`，**源码比快照新时变琥珀色并直接给下一步**（重启 `dsh web`）；`/miliastra/status` 与 `miliastra_health` 共用同一份判据（`host.source.stale` / `deltaMin` / `hint`）。
- **英文入口 + 双语发布说明**：README 顶部加 `[中文] | [English]` 语言锚点与一屏 `## English overview`（是什么 / 30-second quick start / 8 个工具各一行 / 安装三要点 / 四条 ground rules）；发布说明从本版起每版一份中英双语。英文那份**只做导航**，完整参数仍指向生成块 —— 中英不会各维护一份会漂移的副本。
- **「工具速查」补参数说明列**：以前只有类型 / 必填 / 取值，参数描述改了不会进文档；现在一并生成。

### 体验优化

- **文档改成「渐进式披露」**。先量了「谁会进上下文」：工作区 `AGENTS.md` 是**每个会话的模型基线**（531 行 / 26 183 字符），插件 `README.md` 是按需读（1 063 行 / 46 109 字符）。细节下沉后 —— **`AGENTS.md` 155 行 / 6 751 字符（−71%）**、**README 408 行 / 24 876 字符（−46%）**。
- 新增 9 篇按需加载的参考文件：插件 `docs/`（功能详解 / 面板与活文件安全 / 关键知识与能力边界 / 配置与开发）与工作区 `docs/`（客户端控件与按键实测 / 运行时日志与试玩信号 / 使用与安全详述 / 目录结构 / 常用操作）。
- 入口只留「不看就会做错」的东西，并给一张「**你手上在做的事 → 读哪个文件**」的索引。

### 问题修复

- **`op=metrics summaryOnly` 两处真 bug**：`byLevel` 的每一层没有套上瘦身（只瘦了顶层，等于白瘦）；**没有箱子可省时摘要反而比全量更大**（实测 **1601B → 1630B**）。现在「有箱可去才报 `binsOmitted`」，并且每一层都瘦。省体积改用**固定夹具**验证：**546B → 188B**。
- **`smoke` 的 metrics 断言原本写死键名 `x`** → 遇到 23:33 那局（日志里只有 `容器交接值`）**假红**。改成**数据无关**：键集合一致 + 全量里有 `core`/`hotBin` 的摘要里必须还在 + 有箱才报 `binsOmitted`。**别让真机数据的偶然形态决定测试的松紧。**
- 新增两条文档绊线：README 里 `docs/…md` 的链接**必须存在**、`docs/` 下**不许有孤立文件**（没人链接 = 没人会读）；生成块的比对**行尾无关**（CRLF 与 LF 不再导致假红）。

### 其他变更

- **测试 462 项**全绿（`readme-test` 14 / `smoke` 48 / `deploy-test` 30 / `probe-deploy-test` 16 / `lualint-test` 32 / `shot-test` 103 / `playtest-test` 63 / `giaruns-test` 25 / `leveldata-test` 44 / `metrics-test` 39 / `client-render-test` 32，外加技能契约自检 16）。
- 工作区新增一份**复测清单**（`docs/dsh-miliastra_更新说明_夜战补充落地_2026-09-24.md`）：把「哪些做了 / 哪些早就有 / 哪些归工具侧」写清，并给可照抄的复测步骤与真机原文输出。
- 不变的两条老规矩：**Host 半边是启动快照**（改 `index.js` / `lib/*.mjs` 要重启 `dsh web`；只改 `lib/client.js` 刷新页面即可）；**面板没有的功能不代表工具没有** —— 工具 schema 才是唯一真身。

**Full Changelog**: [v0.0.10...v0.0.11](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-miliastra/compare/v0.0.10...v0.0.11)

---

This release follows `v0.0.10` (the first Release). It is a documentation and panel cleanup plus two real bug fixes — **no new tools, and no change to how any tool is called** (all four AI-invocation invariants still hold).

<h3 id="en-v0.0.11">New Features</h3>

- **Panel: a version row plus a Host staleness warning.** The panel never showed its version, and the Host half is a **startup snapshot** — the source reached 0.0.9 at 22:41 while a Host started at 22:18 still reported 0.0.5, which cost five calls to diagnose. The panel header now always shows `Host vX · started HH:MM · source vY`, turning amber with the next step (restart `dsh web`) when the source is newer; `/miliastra/status` and `miliastra_health` share the same verdict (`host.source.stale` / `deltaMin` / `hint`).
- **An English entry point and bilingual release notes**: the README gains a `[中文] | [English]` anchor line and a one-screen `## English overview` (what it is / 30-second quick start / one line per tool / install essentials / four ground rules), and release notes are bilingual from this version on. The English section is **navigation only** — the full parameter reference stays in the generated block, so neither language keeps a copy that can drift.
- **A parameter-description column in the generated tool reference**: previously only type / required / allowed values were rendered, so editing a parameter description never reached the docs.

### Improvements

- **Docs restructured for progressive disclosure.** We first measured what actually enters context: the workspace `AGENTS.md` is the **per-session model baseline** (531 lines / 26,183 chars) while the plugin `README.md` is read on demand (1,063 lines / 46,109 chars). After moving detail out: **`AGENTS.md` is 155 lines / 6,751 chars (−71%)** and the **README is 408 lines / 24,876 chars (−46%)**.
- Nine on-demand reference files were added: plugin `docs/` (feature deep-dives, panel and live-file safety, key knowledge and limits, configuration and development) and workspace `docs/` (client-control and key findings, runtime logs and playtest signals, usage and safety, directory layout, common commands).
- Entry points now keep only "read this or you will get it wrong", plus a "**what you're doing → which file to read**" index.

### Bug Fixes

- **Two real bugs in `op=metrics summaryOnly`**: each `byLevel` layer was shipped unslimmed (only the top level shrank, making the slimming pointless), and when there were no histogram bins to omit the summary was **larger than the full output** (measured **1,601 B → 1,630 B**). `binsOmitted` is now reported only when bins were actually removed, and every layer is slimmed. The size claim is verified with a **fixed fixture**: **546 B → 188 B**.
- **The `smoke` metrics assertion hardcoded the key name `x`**, so it went **falsely red** on the 23:33 run (whose log only contained `容器交接值`). It is now **data-agnostic**: same key set, and any key that had `core`/`hotBin` in the full output must keep them in the summary. **Don't let one incidental log decide how tight a test is.**
- Two new documentation tripwires: every `docs/…md` link in the README must exist, and **no file in `docs/` may be orphaned** (a doc nobody links is a doc nobody reads); and the generated-block comparison is **line-ending agnostic** (CRLF vs LF no longer causes a false failure).

### Chores

- **462 tests**, all green (`readme-test` 14 / `smoke` 48 / `deploy-test` 30 / `probe-deploy-test` 16 / `lualint-test` 32 / `shot-test` 103 / `playtest-test` 63 / `giaruns-test` 25 / `leveldata-test` 44 / `metrics-test` 39 / `client-render-test` 32, plus 16 skill contract self-checks).
- A **retest checklist** was added to the workspace (`docs/dsh-miliastra_更新说明_夜战补充落地_2026-09-24.md`), spelling out what was done, what already existed, and what belongs to the tool side — with copy-paste steps and verbatim machine output.
- Two rules that have not changed: **the Host half is a startup snapshot** (restart `dsh web` after changing `index.js` / `lib/*.mjs`; a page refresh is enough for `lib/client.js`), and **a feature missing from the panel does not mean the tool lacks it** — the tool schema is the single source of truth.

**Full Changelog**: [v0.0.10...v0.0.11](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-miliastra/compare/v0.0.10...v0.0.11)
